question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want Zoe and Howard to try a long distance relationship?
Which part of the interview did you like best?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That may be so, but he and I are not peers.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This insufferable and irritating young man should not address me as anything less than a superior elder.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Superior'? More like `suck`perior!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Superior'? More like [color=#e23b3b][i]suck[/i][/color]perior!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not helping, Hector!
Bertram bristles and turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Kingston Kings know how to address their elders politely and correctly.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And they should know how to pick their friends accordingly.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Come along.
Howard shoots Hector an angry look as he follows Bertram outside.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I fail to see the manner of his respect.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, he thinks Kingston is a fine institution, so he's giving it props.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of like giving it applause.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Is that so? Well, I'm glad even the less eloquent find our school dignified. I'll try not to be insulted.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, good.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I suppose the world has evolved, and language along with it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But I'll grieve the end of the proper salutation later.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Come along, Howard.
Bertram heads outside, but Hector pulls Howard back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey man, sorry about that... I didn't know you were interviewing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem. I think it worked itself out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good luck! Catch you later!
Hector walks back into the restaurant, and Howard follows Bertram outside.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, it was simply splendid!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Howard, do you know this opera?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... I know what opera is...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Splendid! Would you describe the main singer's voice as dramatic, lyric, or coloratura?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Err... Lyric?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Why do you think that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because she seems `lyric`al?
nodes.text_bbcode: Because she seems [color=#e23b3b][i]lyric[/i][/color]al?

nodes.text: Arthur stares at Howard...
Then bursts into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Ha ha! Bloomsburg, keep this one around. He is of a cultured background indeed.
They proceed to talk more of music, art, and literature. Finally, at the end of lunch...
Arthur shakes Howard's hand.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I can see you fitting right in at Kingston, young man.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, sir.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Good show, old sport.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I hope we shall meet again.
Arthur moves away from their table.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I've rarely seen him take that warmly to anyone. You must have made a good impression.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er.... Color-whatever?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No... That's not how I'd describe her at all.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I have to say... I was hoping you'd have more of an appreciation for the opera.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: It's a shame that our youth nowadays has no idea what culture is really about.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It is indeed, sir. It is indeed.
Arthur shoves away from the table and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, I believe I see someone I must mingle with. Carry on.
Arthur strides away.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He left in a hurry. He's usually so talkative.
They eat the rest of their meal in silence. When lunch is over, Bertram stands up.
Howard stands up to follow Bertram out of the lunch hall when he runs into Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Howard... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I, uh, I'm on a date with Amanda. Hey, I'm glad I ran into you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I got an issue...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I were making out in the broom closet of this place...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Which was kind of a bad idea because some janitor totally walked in on us and kicked us out...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...So then we moved things to the girls' bathroom, but there was this incident with the `toilet paper...`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So then we moved things to the girls' bathroom, but there was this incident with the [color=#e23b3b][i]toilet paper...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard cuts him off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, as much I'd like to help you... I'm a little busy...
Howard jerks his head at Bertram.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, you know this young man?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We went to Twin Branches together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, this man is from `Kingston University.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, this man is from [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston University.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hector puts a hand out for Bertram to shake.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's up, dawg?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: 'Dog'? I see no such mangy creature...
Hector claps Bertram on the back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, man, I'm talking about you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've heard about your school, College Recruiter Guy. Your college is awesome! Props, man. Serious props.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I beg your pardon! I am no two-bit actor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mr. Bloomsburg, I'm so sorry... This is how he is.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Insulting?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's not insulting you! He's being...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Yes! Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He just said that she was `not` an alto.
nodes.text_bbcode: He just said that she was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] an alto.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No, I remember now! The singer is a soprano.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: No... A contralto has the `lowest` voice.
nodes.text_bbcode: No... A contralto has the [color=#e23b3b][i]lowest[/i][/color] voice.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I remember now! The singer is a soprano.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Speaking of music, I saw an opera at the theater this past weekend. It was one you've been wanting to see.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: 'Orfeo ed Euridice'? Yes! What were your impressions?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I enjoyed the voice of Euridice herself...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: She is an alto?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No. She sings higher than that. She's...
Arthur turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: You know the term I'm looking for, don't you? A singer who can hit the highest notes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, you mean a...

nodes.prompt: A singer who hits the highest notes is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: A singer who hits the highest notes is...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Indeed! His unfinished masterpiece still haunts me to this day.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: As it does me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, me three... Too!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We are talking of Chopin, not Michelangelo!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Chopin was a great composer!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We are talking of Chopin, not Emerson!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Chopin was a great composer!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He was an inventor, a scientist, a philosopher...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He could do many things!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Which you delineated in your article most eloquently.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, once I read your paper, it put me in the mood for Chopin.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Another figure of exceptional humanity.
They look over at Howard expectantly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Chopin. He created incredible...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: How pedestrian.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't he paint the, uh, Mona Lisa?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes, of course, but he was so much more than that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Da Vinci was famous for more than just the Mona Lisa, right?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes! I'm happy to see the public school system has raised its standards in the last few years.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: That is insulting!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Da Vinci was not the winner of some paltry fair prize.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe I'm thinking of someone else.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Da Vinci was an incredible man of history!
A short while later, Howard walks Bertram Bloomsburg through this new section of the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I think that overall you've done some good work. The park looks better than it did before!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm kind of impressed, Howard. Everyone responds to your leadership.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This reflects very well on you. This is the kind of initiative we look for in Kings...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you for showing me this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so glad to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know it's, uh, not perfect...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That it is not. In fact, I believe the park looks much worse than it did before...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Your dedication to your community is positive...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But it is important to note that we look for men who can follow through with their promises.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And in this case, I believe you might have let the park down.
Bertram clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: In any case, I think our time here is done. We have a luncheon to get to.
A short drive later...
Bertram leads Howard into the private back room of a fancy restaurant where several people are milling about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who are all these people?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: These are all representatives from Kingston. I brought you to this luncheon so that you could meet other Kingston Kings.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: All of these men have accomplished great things. There's a geneticist over there who's had a hand in mapping the human genome...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And that man over there is a Nobel Laureate. And the man in tweed over there invented the first canine milking machine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It's more profitable than you'd think!
Eventually, Bertram leads Howard to a table. They are soon joined by a friendly-looking man.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, this is Arthur Billingsly. He's the Dean of Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Arthur, this is Howard, a potential candidate for our Kingston King program.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: How delightful!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Bertram, I hope you don't mind catching up a bit.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I read your paper on the early exploits of Leonardo da Vinci.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The one I wrote in my sophomore year?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: The very one. And I must say, it's quite brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Of course it is. I wrote it.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Leonardo da Vinci was truly a Renaissance man.
Arthur turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: You are familiar with the term?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh... They actually want me to talk about cultural stuff? Here goes nothing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course. A Renaissance man is someone who...

nodes.prompt: A Renaissance man is someone who...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: A Renaissance man is someone who...

nodes.text: Howard grabs a towel from the pile of supplies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're going to take this towel and wipe off what you've written.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hopefully, the paint will just come off straight away.
Howard watches Ryan futilely rub at the spray paint, but it just creates a blur of paint!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Forget it! It's never coming off! And it's just a mess now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me try.
Howard scrubs at the wall, but finds that he can't get the paint off either.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So what now, wise guy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess we just leave it... Hopefully it doesn't ruin the park too much...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So can I get out of here now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Go.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? How does that make any sense?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you'll probably smear all the paint if you try to wash it off now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And to be honest... What you have isn't actually that bad...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, if you finish it up, maybe people will think it's a mural or something.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I guess it's better than scrubbing it all off.
Ryan finishes up his graffiti, and a mural of abstract shapes stares back at them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, it looks like it kind of belongs there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right... You're free to go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good work, Ryan. I'll put in a good word with Judge Shao for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh, what?
Howard turns around...
And finds Ryan spray painting a crude drawing of himself directly over the mural!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ryan, what are you doing?! You're supposed to be washing the graffiti off, not putting on more!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I figured if I was going to wash it off anyway, I'd have some fun first.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, `I'm` having fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] having fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Somehow I don't think the judge that gave you community service will agree with you...
Howard studies the wall.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. There's not much time left. Here's what you're going to do. You're going to...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!
They lift the tree together and place it into a freshly dug hole in the ground.
Phil shovels dirt around the tree, anchoring it into place.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That worked! Hey, would you mind helping with this other one over here?
Howard and Phil plant two more trees.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard! I can take it from here...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!
Phil lifts, but Howard doesn't!
Phil's force makes him slip and stumble into the grass!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, man... What gives? You didn't lift on three!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope I didn't strain something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Try again?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'll just do it myself.
Phil looks around and sees a shovel. He uses it to get the tree out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, uh, good work, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks. Go check up on someone else now.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
Phil lifts, but Howard doesn't!
Phil's force makes him slip and stumble into the grass!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, man... What gives? You didn't lift on three!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope I didn't strain something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Try again?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'll just do it myself.
Phil looks around and sees a shovel. He uses it to get the tree out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, uh, good work, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks. Go check up on someone else now.
Howard turns away from them and checks on Phil.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Good. But this one tree's giving me some trouble. It's so heavy that I can't even push it into the hole.
Phil points to a tree with a thick trunk. Howard gives it a pull, but it doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think we can pick the tree up if we try it together.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Great! Let's lift it on three!
They brace themselves around the tree.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: One...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Two...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Do I lift on three or after three?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you'll never know who's better unless you try it, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So let's see who can get things done the fastest.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll give you each a section to weed out of, and however many weeds you pull out will determine the winner.
Zach turns to Spencer, his eyes narrowed.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: All right.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And we'll get the work done faster too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zach, you're going to take the flower bed on the right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Spencer, you take the one on the left.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you guys ready?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go!
Zach and Spencer go at it for several minutes, pulling weeds out maniacally.
After a few minutes, the flower beds look visibly better!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great jobs, guys!
Howard glances back to Bertram. He's scribbling on his clipboard, but he's nodding his head.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Never. I'm not sorry for anything!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm only sorry you got in the way.
Spencer lunges at Zach again, and they start trampling the daisies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys!
Howard tries to intervene, but Spencer accidentally hits him hard in the face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ow!
Spencer looks back and pulls away from Zach.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard. But you knew it was coming.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys! Seriously! This is `super` important to me! Can you maybe try and `not` ruin my life?
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys! Seriously! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] important to me! Can you maybe try and [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] ruin my life?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Fine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That could have gone better...
Howard glances back to Bertram. He's scribbling with a frown on his face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well? What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd `love` to hear your advice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two should definitely apologize to one another!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember above all that you're `capable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember above all that you're [color=#3b78e2][i]capable.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what? You're right! And I just thought of something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know exactly how I can show the Kingston rep that I'm a responsible member of the community.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but I'm going to have to spend the rest of the morning putting it together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I understand. I have to get home anyway.
Zoe kisses him on the nose as she rises to leave.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now get to work! And good luck on your interview!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!
As soon as $ZOE leaves, Howard reaches for his phone...
Later that afternoon, Howard enters the park and finds a man in a business suit waiting with a clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You must be Howard. I'm Bertram Bloomsburg IV, former Kingston King and regional representative for Kingston University.
Bertram holds out his hand which Howard shakes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you. Thanks for coming here.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I will admit that I was surprised by your request to meet in the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Normally, I like to converse with prospective candidates about their resume...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And of course, I'm happy to answer any questions about my resume, but I brought you here to show you what I can achieve.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Being a Kingston King means having a civic responsibility, a duty to your community.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Indeed.
Bertram scribbles something on his clipboard, but Howard can't make it out.
Nervously, Howard brings Bertram over to a group of guys huddled in the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mr. Bloomsburg, these are friends that I called this morning for a community service project to beautify the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Interesting. We only just spoke yesterday. How did you manage to plan all this so quickly?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It helps being the captain of the football team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I figured you would appreciate seeing my leadership skills in action.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you don't mind staying here and watching, it'll only be an hour or so.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Proceed. I find myself most intrigued.
Howard goes over to the group and starts talking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, guys. Huddle up! Thanks for being here for me. This is what your community service is going to entail.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zach, Spencer, you're in charge of the weeding over there by the sandbox.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Weeding?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, you're going to be standing up some trees.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's like Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And what about me? What do `I` do?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what about me? What do [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ryan?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That stupid judge says I have to do mandatory community service, so he assigned me to clean up the park!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way. Nuh-uh. Not after what you did at my last interview.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Look, man, getting into a fight with you was a bad call. I'm sorry about that. But I'm stuck here, and that means you're stuck with me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! I know! Maybe I could go help by that gazebo!
Ryan points to the gazebo where a couple of cute girls are talking in the shade of its eaves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, not gonna happen. Why don't you go clean the graffiti off that wall instead?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Weak! Mandatory community service blows!
Bertram and Howard walk around while the boys beautify the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: How long have you been the captain of the football team?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For a couple years now. It's a really great team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the guys are really good for work like this.
Howard watches over the football players when suddenly there's a large commotion in the garden.
Howard runs over to find Zach and Spencer pushing one another.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys... Break it up!
Howard separates the two of them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's going on here? You two are supposed to be working together, not fighting.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: He's the one who started it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, maybe I wouldn't have started it if it wasn't for your stupid face!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You're the one with the stupid face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not anyone's stupid face. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spencer was bragging about how he was way better at working than I am...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So I pushed him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, except that before I did that... He was telling me what a loser I am!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It sounds like you two need to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's an important quality in a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But do you think it's enough to be honest?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course it is. Sometimes being honest is the hardest thing in the world to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's an admirable quality.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even more than being honest...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's an important quality in a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But do you think it's enough to be smart?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course it is. We need smart leaders who can predict what's going to happen in the future.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kingston will love you for that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even more than being smart...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I believe you are someone who has a clear vision of what you are looking for in a school.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And you're someone who I believe will go on to do great things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad I gave that impression.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm not entirely convinced you have your priorities in order.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And I'm not confident that you know exactly what you want to do with your life.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You certainly don't always communicate that with your words and actions.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I really blew the interview, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It wasn't your best effort.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... Did I get in?
Bertram heaves a large sigh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I have to weigh all the pros and cons of each candidate.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Last time you were interviewed, we had to cancel it because you got into a fight.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now, I know that wasn't your fault, but we have to be very careful of who we choose to be at Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not everyone has that special spark that is required and expected of a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well... I'm saying that you might not have that spark.
At that moment, they come across the football bleachers, and $ZOE runs up to them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, good! You're just in time! Come over here!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, what is this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess it's something my girlfriend pulled together.
$ZOE leads them to the front of the football field where a large crowd of people are sitting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... What exactly is going on? Where are you taking me and Mr. Bloomsburg?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I thought it might help Mr. Bloomsburg's decision to hear just what kind of person you are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I brought together every student in our school who's gotten to know Howard over the years...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's hear what they have to say!
Zoe starts passing the mic around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What makes me a Kingston King is that I'm honest.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They always say that honesty is the best policy, and I always tell the truth.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not to discount your best quality...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But many of our candidates are equally honest, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But honesty is a fine quality in a young man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Does that mean I got in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What makes me a Kingston King is that I'm smart.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm always thinking up new projects and figuring out problems.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not to discount that quality, but...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We have many smart candidates applying for the position.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But don't let what I said go to your head. We wouldn't be interviewing you if we didn't believe you had potential.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Did I get in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have many strengths, but I think my greatest one is that I'm capable.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Care to explain what that means exactly?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I want to do something big with my life.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I believe I have the resources and means to get everything I want out of it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That is an important quality, and one I'd like to see in more of your generation.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Does that mean I got in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You know what? Nevermind!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Did I get in?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This brings me to my last question...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why do you think that `you` are the strongest candidate to be a Kingston King?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do you think that [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are the strongest candidate to be a Kingston King?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I must say, I'm surprised. Most people choose famous figures, influential people who inspire.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My girlfriend is an inspiration.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's always there to support me, she's kind and generous, and she makes me want to be a better man.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well said, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why are your sisters your inspiration?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're little troublemakers. They're always making a name for themselves in all their classes with their pranks and jokes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My mom used to get so many calls from their terrified teachers over the years. It was pretty intense.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You want to be a troublemaker, known only for your infamy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I just meant that I didn't want to lose my sense of humor, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When you say it like that, it sounds bad.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Indeed.
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Who is Mr. Doom?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, he's an urban legend. He's this grotesque, disfigured creature who used to live in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why on earth is he someone who's influential in your life?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He used to terrorize all the Twin Branches kids. We'd never venture in the woods at night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd say that's pretty influential...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I see.
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.
Howard just gapes at Bertram. He is unable to say anything.
The silence stretches long and awkward between them.
Eventually, Bertram clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Let's move on, shall we?
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Next question... Tell me who has been the most influential person in your life.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I know you were previously interviewed for the football scholarship..

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But surely you want to attend Kingston for more than just its `sports` team.
nodes.text_bbcode: But surely you want to attend Kingston for more than just its [color=#e23b3b][i]sports[/i][/color] team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course I do, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Football is the first thing that popped into my head.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I visited Centerscore University a short time ago.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I found I was very interested in their sports medicine program.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But they didn't have enough classes to support it as a major.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They told me Kingston's program is supposed to be one of the best ones, and that's what I want to study.
Bertram smiles and nods as he jots down notes on his clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I beg your pardon?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, Kingston really sounds like a fun school to go to.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Kingston is not a party school!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I hope you know that Kingston prides itself on its cultural and academic experience.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not on the level of enjoyment one derives from its parties.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, that's only one reason why I'd like to go there.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But apparently it is the only one that matters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Um...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should I have a good reason?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I should hope so.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The point and the match are `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The point and the match are [color=#e23b3b][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bertram bows curtly to Howard, and Howard returns the awkward gesture.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not exactly your finest hour, was it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Still, you `did` hold your own for a while there...
nodes.text_bbcode: Still, you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] hold your own for a while there...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And you may yet prove yourself to be Kingston material in other arenas...
The tip of his foil scrapes against Bertram's cheek, putting a red welt across his face!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Ahh!` My stately, handsome face! Illegal hit!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color] My stately, handsome face! Illegal hit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am `so` sorry... I don't normally go around giving people welts!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry... I don't normally go around giving people welts!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: No matter.
Howard drives the tip of his foil against Bertram's chest!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact. The point and the match are yours!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well fought!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, sir.
Howard jabs the tip of his foil against Bertram's unprotected thighs slicing off his pants below the knees!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Ahh!` You've given me knickers! Illegal hit!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color] You've given me knickers! Illegal hit!

nodes.text: Bertram and Howard line up again, trading attacks, parries, and ripostes until the score is two to two.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well, it seems we're even. It all comes down to this!
Bertram and Howard tap blades! Immediately, Bertram goes on the offensive. He feints to the side and thrusts!
Howard parries the attack and then ripostes, driving the tip of his foil straight toward Bertram's...
Howard jabs! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Bertram's chest before he can steady himself!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...UFF![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact! Well done, Howard! The point is `yours.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Contact! Well done, Howard! The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]yours.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I did it!
Howard jerks his foil to the side, but parries empty air! Bertram seizes the blunder and thrusts!
The blunted tip of his foil pokes Howard's chest!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... My point!
Howard hesitates!
As if in slow motion, he can see Bertram advance...
He moves to parry, but hits empty air! Bertram seizes the blunder and thrusts!
The blunted tip of his foil pokes Howard's chest!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... My point!
Bertram and Howard return to the center of the mat. They tap their blades to signal the start of the point...
Bertram hops deftly back. He feints forward and, for one instant, is off balance! Howard quickly...
Howard levels his blade to jab, but Bertram is faster! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Howard in the chest before he can even move!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... The point is `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Contact... The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard jerks his foil, batting the tip of Bertram's blade harmlessly to the side!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha!
Bertram stumbles forward, and his momentum carries him off the edge of the mat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Skillful deflection, Howard. The point is `yours.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Skillful deflection, Howard. The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]yours.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Uncertain what to do, Howard attacks!
He levels his blade to jab, but Bertram is faster! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Howard in the chest before he can even move!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... The point is `mine.`

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Given that you've never fenced before, I'll clarify the rules...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now let us adjourn to the `piste.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now let us adjourn to the [color=#e23b3b][i]piste.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, okay... I guess I did have a bunch of glasses of water with lunch.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The `piste` is the mat that we will fence upon!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]piste[/i][/color] is the mat that we will fence upon!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That makes more sense... Especially since I can't locate the zipper on this jacket thing.
Howard and Bertram take position at the middle of a long mat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Never...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm hoping that fencing skills aren't a requirement for the scholarship... I just don't want to lie.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you for being honest with me, Howard...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's better than being skewered in a fight...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The sad truth is that these days, most of our students have never felt the thrill of wielding a supple blade.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I don't have to fence...?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: On the contrary, you absolutely must! But I will assess you based on your promise, not your skill.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Too small...? The fit `seems` all right to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Too small...? The fit [color=#e23b3b][i]seems[/i][/color] all right to me.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But if you know enough to properly evaluate the fit of your safety equipment, you must have some experience fencing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, but...
Bertram scurries back over to the rack and returns with a larger jacket.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are.
Howard puts the jacket on. The collar hangs loose around his throat, and the sleeves dangle several inches below his hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This... This is perfect.
They walk a short distance from the restaurant to a large building.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This way, this way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, where are we going?
Bertram flips a switch on the wall. There is a chunk-chunk sound as banks of lights turn on revealing an open area with a long mat.
Along the walls are racks filled with gleaming foils, epees, and rapiers.
And just ahead are practice dummies wearing padded white jackets and wire-mesh masks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Any prospective Kingston man must demonstrate proficiency at 'the sport of gentlemanly pokes'...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... That sounds kind of...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Fencing...` The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is `fencing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fencing...[/i][/color] The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is [color=#e23b3b][i]fencing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, `wow,` that is a relief...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]wow,[/i][/color] that is a relief...

nodes.text: Betram steps over to the practice dummies and retrieves two white fencing jackets. He offers one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are. Now put this on.
Howard struggles into the padded jacket, wrestling with the straps to secure it into place.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: What's the matter, Howard? You have put on fencing attire before, have you not?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Fencing is a game of points.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: A fencer can score a point in one of two ways, either by landing a hit to his opponent's torso or by driving his opponent off the edge of the `piste.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A fencer can score a point in one of two ways, either by landing a hit to his opponent's torso or by driving his opponent off the edge of the [color=#e23b3b][i]piste.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We'll play to three points. Is that acceptable?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... I mean, you know best.
Bertram raises his left arm for balance and extends his sword hand. He taps the tip of his blade against yours.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Then we begin... `En garde!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then we begin... [color=#e23b3b][i]En garde![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `En garde!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]En garde![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bertram hops deftly back. He waggles his foil in a circle and `thrusts!` Howard quickly...
nodes.text_bbcode: Bertram hops deftly back. He waggles his foil in a circle and [b]thrusts![/b] Howard quickly...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, uh, Mr. Bloomsburg, what's next? Horseback riding? Driving around in a golden car? Caviar-eating contest?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Your imagination is certainly active.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I actually believe that we'll spend the last of our time together on a walk.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: There are some things I'd like to clear up with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course.
Suddenly Howard's phone beeps.
It's a text from $ZOE that reads, 'Meet me at the football field. Bring your interviewer too!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, if you want to visit my school, it's just up the road.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can show you the football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That would be a delight.
Bertram and Howard walk around the large football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: So, we're getting to the end of our time together, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. And then you make your decision about whether or not I get in.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes. But first, I have a few final questions to ask you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why did you choose Kingston University?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I want to go to Kingston for many reasons. But above all, I want to go for Kingston's...
They walk a short distance from the restaurant to a large building.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This way, this way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, where are we going?
Bertram flips a switch on the wall. There is a chunk-chunk sound as banks of lights turn on revealing an open area with a long mat.
Along the walls are racks filled with gleaming foils, epees, and rapiers.
And just ahead are practice dummies wearing padded white jackets and wire-mesh masks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Any prospective Kingston man must demonstrate proficiency at 'the sport of gentlemanly pokes'...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... That sounds kind of...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Fencing...` The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is `fencing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fencing...[/i][/color] The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is [color=#e23b3b][i]fencing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, `wow,` that is a relief...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]wow,[/i][/color] that is a relief...

nodes.text: Betram steps over to the practice dummies and retrieves two white fencing jackets. He offers one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are. Now put this on.
Howard struggles into the padded jacket, wrestling with the straps to secure it into place.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: What's the matter, Howard? You have put on fencing attire before, have you not?
One by one, all the friends, all the people whose life Howard was a part of, walk up to the stage and speak for him.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What can I say? Howard's my best man.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whether it's proving our innocence after being wrongly accused or throwing the best party ever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's awesome! I know that Howard's got my back. We're friends for life.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love Howard!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But not more then Hector!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: All the cheerleaders loved having Howard around! He's so sweet and nice!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And good-looking and hot, and you should `totally` see him in his football uniform and...
nodes.text_bbcode: And good-looking and hot, and you should [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] see him in his football uniform and...

nodes.text: $ZOE plucks the mic out of Nicole's hands and passes it on.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Howard's been a great football captain. He's always been there for us football players. On and off the field.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We trust him to lead us, and he really deserves the very best.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Speaking for the nerds, Howard's never picked on any of us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But more than that, he's a good guy to lean on.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He got me through a very hard time when I was breaking up with my ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I've been much happier since then!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I could have lunch with one historical figure, it'd be Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: After him, it'd be... Well, it'd probably be Abe Lincoln.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then Martin Luther King would be a hoot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if it had to be a guy who was still alive, it'd be Howard!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't entirely hate his guts.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Anyone with a girlfriend that hot has to be doing something right.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: He's an average guy.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd even say he's okay.
They sit down, and $ZOE speaks into the mic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For them, that's a compliment!
Everyone in the crowd laughs, and $ZOE waits for them to calm down.
Then she takes a breath and starts speaking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think this whole school is going to miss Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As football captain, team leader, and positive friend, Howard's touched all of our lives in an unforgettable way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Loyal and kind, fierce and gentle... Howard is one of the best guys around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll miss you, Howard.
At $ZOE finishes her speech, Howard takes the microphone and addresses the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All I have to say is... Thank you. Thank you, everyone, for your kind words.
Howard steps down to everyone's applause.
As people file off the field, Bertram meets Howard and $ZOE at the edges of the football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, I was wrong about you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I said that you were missing the one spark that would make you a real leader.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But after seeing everyone here speak up for you...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I know for certain that you're a real Kingston King. Congratulations, you're in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? I am?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He is?!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He is.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And young lady...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We reward initiative at Kingston, and I believe your ability to gather such a crowd for a cause you care about is an impressive feat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We could use someone with your influence. When your time comes, you should consider applying for Kingston too.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You would be a resourceful Kingston King, er, Queen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I will!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now Howard, you're going to be flying out first thing tomorrow morning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Tomorrow?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Tomorrow?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes, there's a summer training orientation for Kingston Kings. It starts at 9 o'clock sharp.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'll see you there.
Bertram heads out, and Howard and $ZOE look sadly at one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm happy I got in, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm leaving tomorrow.
Howard looks down at $ZOE whose eyes have suddenly filled with tears.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I... I think this is goodbye for us.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After all our time together, after we got you back from Paris, after everything else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It doesn't seem fair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we... We could make it work... You know, long-distance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...No. I don't think we can. We've `seen` what that does to people. We've seen how it goes.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...No. I don't think we can. We've [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] what that does to people. We've seen how it goes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to remember us like this, Howard. Happy. Fulfilled. In love. Not... Not torn apart and longing and jealous.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should end on a good note. It's right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just don't forget about me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never.
Howard pulls $ZOE into a fierce hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this isn't goodbye forever, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You heard Mr. Bloomsburg. Maybe when it's time for me to graduate... We can be together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But until then...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Goodbye, Howard...
She leans into him, their foreheads touching. He pushes a lock of hair out of her face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Goodbye, $ZOE... I'll always love you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'll always love you.
A warm breeze envelops them as Howard and $ZOE kiss for the last time in the fading summer light.
Well, that was a hard ending, but it is the good one! Congratulations! You helped Howard get into Kingston and have a good last moment with $ZOE!
But what will happen to $ZOE now that Howard's gone? Find out during the next school year of Surviving High School!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: The microphone gets passed on through the crowd, each person voicing their opinion of Howard.
Unfortunately, it starts out bad... And becomes worse...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Howard is, like, totally hot.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah! Totally!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Howard `is` the coach of our football team...
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] the coach of our football team...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But other than that, he's a perfectly average guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is totally not helping my case...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Howard's been the best wingman a guy could have.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's been by my side for every heist, every prank, and every illegal thing we've done!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Illegal?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Illegal?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... It's probably just a figure of speech?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard, good buddy, good pal... We've had a lot of good times making our rap sheets as long as possible! Live the dream!
Hector passes the mic on to Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Howard's a total tool with his total tool girlfriend and his total tool football team.
$ZOE wrests the microphone away from Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, that's all the encouragement we need! Thanks for turning out!
As everyone leaves the football field, $ZOE runs up to them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That didn't go as well as I'd hoped.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please, Mr. Bloomsburg... I'm sorry. I gathered everyone here to show you how important Howard was to the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope I didn't leave you with a bad impression of him.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I've heard enough about Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: A sordid relationship with the law, a tenuous grasp of friendship, and no honors of note.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm hard-pressed to imagine that Kingston would accept anyone who keeps such company.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...
Bertram turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Pulling together this entire event belies your passion, your resourcefulness, and your ingenuity.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: $ZOE, how would you like to enroll into our Kingston King program?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? But she's not even graduating!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: In the exception of exceptional students, we consider early acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is such an honor, sir...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I can say 'no'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I accept!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Great. I'll send along the details. We'll meet at the airport tomorrow!
$ZOE turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard. But you know how good a school Kingston is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't pass this up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you... But I have to go pack!
$ZOE kisses him on the cheek and runs off!
$ZOE boards a plane for Kingston while Howard gets rejected?
We don't have to tell you that this is a terrible ending!
Try again and see if you can help Howard `wow` Bertram!

Later that night, Howard tells his family the good news.
...And then he told me that I was accepted!
Howard, that is wonderful news! Congratulations!
Cathy playfully nudges Horace.
See, Horace? I told you he'd turn out all right in the end.
I'm glad to see dropping him as a baby didn't do any permanent damage...
What?
Nothing, dear!
It all worked out in the end. That's what we need to focus on.
Our firstborn son is making a man of himself and going to a prestigious institution!
We're set for life!
This calls for a celebration!
Break out the cake!
There's cake?
I made one just for you...
What if I hadn't gotten in?
Then it would be a consolation cake, instead of congratulations.
Thanks, Mom.
It's your favorite. Chocolate cake, buttercream frosting, with rainbow sprinkles.
Awesome!
Yay! Cake! I love cake!
Keekk... Kak....
I love it when Howard gets into college!
Turns out that Howard likes it when Howard gets into college too!
But I guess that means you're leaving for good, huh?
You won't ever come home again!
That's so sad!
Aren't you two sweet?
But if he doesn't come back home again, one of us can get his room!
Yeah! Like me!
Or me!
I take back what I said...
I want his room!
I thought of it first!
Howard's mom sets a cake down in between them.
Howard's room will remain his room for now.
Awww...
Can't it even be a little bit ours?
Nope.
Take that, twins!
You girls can have your own rooms when your grades come up. If you're going to follow in your brother's footsteps...
You've got quite a bit of work ahead of you.
And you can thank Howard for setting the bar so high.
Aw, man...
This sucks. Thanks a lot, Howard.
Don't worry. You'll get your grades up. You have time, so you'll get there eventually...
But for now, at least there's cake.
Looks like a lot of things are changing for everyone!

nodes.title: A Kingston King
nodes.subtitle: Can Howard prove he's worthy of Kingston?

nodes.text: It's the morning of Howard's interview with Kingston University, and Zoe is talking with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how are you holding up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so glad that Kingston's decided to give me another chance to get in, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm nervous about this interview. There's just a huge knot where my stomach used to be.
$ZOE pats him on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's hard, but you can do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were prepared for the last interview, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I was. But this is going to be nothing like the last interview.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What's different?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, last time, I was qualifying for a football scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My interviewer wasn't going to ask me any hard questions about what I want to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their `Kingston Kings` leadership program.
nodes.text_bbcode: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston Kings[/i][/color] leadership program.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Kingston Kings are the elite leaders of the school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're involved in almost everything, and they usually go on to become prestigious politicians or super rich businessmen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I want to go to Kingston, I have to prove I'm going to be a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all just too much, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, that does sound intense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you're anxious, but you're going to do fine! You're a wonderful guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, but unfortunately 'good boyfriend' isn't one of the qualities they're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are they looking for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I was preparing for the interview, I found some materials that classify Kingston Kings as men of civic responsibility, culture, and honor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's good. You `are` all those things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's good. You [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] all those things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But can I prove that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you can't go into an interview thinking like that! Come on, say one nice thing about yourself before you start...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'm...

nodes.text: I suppose you're correct... Very well..
